SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS num_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, AVG(t.total_consumption) AS avg_total
  FROM totals t
  JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100
  / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS pct_eur_customers
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND substr(t.Date, 6, 2) = '06';
note: Query is well-formed and matches the schema, but transactions_1k only contains dates from 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26 (it is a 1,000-row sample), so no June 2013 transactions exist and the result set is empty.
